mail.subject: 5 minutes: your feedback on {product}
mail.body:
Dear {name} team,

We are developing {product} at the United Nations and would very much like to hear what you think. [One sentence: what it is and who it is for.]

Could you take about [5-10] minutes to answer a short anonymous survey?
{link}

The survey is open until {deadline}. At the end you will find a box where you can also tell us how we could improve the survey itself, and a box for ideas on what we should make next.

You are welcome to share the link with other members of your group. [Optional: we will send you a short summary of the results.]

If you would rather not receive requests like this, just reply and we will take you off our list.

Thank you very much for your time!

Best regards,

reminder_intro: A short reminder: the survey below is still open until {deadline}. If you have already answered, thank you, and please ignore this mail.
